verdict.rationale: Supermemory is a memory API with connectors that auto-sync content. A buyer could reasonably ask whether its automated flows, such as connector syncs, can be versioned, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. Document updates via customId and document update/delete operations concern ingested content, not automation definitions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
